name: std::mersenne_twister_engine<UIntType,w,n,m,r,a,u,d,s,b,t,c,l,f>::discard
intro: Advances the internal state by z times.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
z

 -

 integer value specifying the number of times to advance the state by

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: No worse than the complexity of z consecutive calls to operator().

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function can use “fast jump” algorithms which advance the state by many steps (order of millions) without calculating intermediate state transitions can be used instead of naive loops that calls operator() z times and discarding the result.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Two engines start with seed 42. Advancing one by discard(3) matches three calls to the other.

summary: Advances the internal state by z times.
